question: Bahia Governor Election Winner
resolution_criteria:
The Bahia gubernatorial election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026, with a runoff on October 25, 2026, if no candidate receives a majority of the valid votes in the first round.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder governors appointed by any means before the specified election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes).

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
# Bahia Governor 2026: research brief (as of 2026-09-14)

In short: going by sources dated up to September 14, this is a two-way race between Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT, the incumbent) and ACM Neto (União Brasil). The most recent polls show them statistically tied. None of the other listed names appears to be running for governor. I left out every source dated after September 14.

## 1. Resolution source
- The official source is the TSE results page (tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes). As of September 14 no results exist, since the first round is October 4 and a possible runoff is October 25. I did not fetch the TSE page.
- 2026-08-15: The deadline for registering candidates closed. Seven governor candidates are reported: ACM Neto (União), Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT), Ronaldo Mansur (PSOL), Aroldo Felix (UP), Ariel Capistrano (DC), Estêvão (DC) and Maria Bona (PCO). Two DC names are listed, which may reflect a replacement. One report said ACM Neto's registration was still awaiting a ruling. [Poder360](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/saiba-quem-sao-os-candidatos-ao-governo-da-bahia-em-2026/), [Bahia Notícias](https://www.bahianoticias.com.br/noticia/320977-eleicoes-2026-quem-sao-os-candidatos-ao-governo-da-bahia)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the race yet.
- Other names on the answer list:
  - Rui Costa and João Roma are running for Senate, not governor. Both appear in the Senate polls.
  - Kleber Rosa is not on the governor list. PSOL's candidate is Ronaldo Mansur.
  - I found no sign that José Carlos Aleluia or Bruno Reis registered for governor.
  - So in practice, a win by Mansur or any minor candidate counts as "Other".

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-09: Real Time Big Data poll, fieldwork September 4-8, 1,600 voters, margin of error ±2 points:
  - First round: Jerônimo 45%, ACM Neto 44%.
  - Runoff: Jerônimo 46%, ACM Neto 45%.
  - Senate: Rui Costa 26%, Wagner 19%, Roma 17%. [Poder360](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/jeronimo-e-acm-neto-empatam-em-pesquisa-eleitoral-na-bahia-diz-pesquisa/)
- 2026-09-03: AtlasIntel poll, 1,804 respondents, margin ±2 points:
  - First round: ACM Neto 48.8%, Jerônimo 47.5%, Mansur 1.1%. In valid votes that is ACM Neto 50.0% vs 48.7%.
  - Runoff: ACM Neto 49.2%, Jerônimo 48.6%. [DGABC](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4344838/pesquisa-atlas-acm-neto-tem-48-8-e-jeronimo-rodrigues-soma-47-5-na-bahia)
- 2026-08-03: Paraná Pesquisas poll, fieldwork July 31 to August 2, 1,400 voters: ACM Neto 48.9%, Jerônimo 38.7% in the first round, and 50.9% vs 40% head to head. [SBT News](https://sbtnews.sbt.com.br/noticia/politica/parana-pesquisas-na-ba-acm-neto-tem-48-9-e-jeronimo-38-7), [CartaCapital](https://www.cartacapital.com.br/politica/a-disputa-entre-acm-neto-e-jeronimo-pelo-governo-da-bahia-segundo-nova-pesquisa/)
- 2026-07-29: Genial/Quaest poll, fieldwork July 23-27:
  - First round: ACM Neto 39%, Jerônimo 38%.
  - Runoff: ACM Neto 43%, Jerônimo 39%.
  - Rejection: Jerônimo 40%, ACM Neto 30%.
  - Approval of Jerônimo's government: 57%.
  - This was Quaest's first poll after the Banco Master scandal reached PT figures in Bahia. [CNN Brasil](https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/eleicoes/quaest-acm-neto-e-jeronimo-empatam-em-1o-e-2o-turno-para-governo-da-bahia/), [O Povo](https://www.opovo.com.br/noticias/politica/eleicoes/2026/07/29/qual-o-cenario-da-disputa-entre-acm-neto-e-jeronimo-na-bahia.html)
- 2026-07-01: Paraná Pesquisas poll: ACM Neto 49.2%, Jerônimo 37.5%. [CNN Brasil](https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/eleicoes/parana-pesquisas-acm-neto-supera-jeronimo-na-disputa-pelo-governo-da-bahia/)
- Trend: ACM Neto's lead in the summer polls narrowed to a tie by early September, which is around when free TV and radio campaign ads began.
- Background on the Banco Master scandal: the federal investigation touches PT figures in Bahia (Wagner, Rui Costa, and payroll-loan products tied to the state). ACM Neto also has reported consulting ties to the bank. Both camps have reportedly avoided the topic. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/republica/silencio-une-adversarios-e-possivel-acordo-faz-master-virar-assunto-proibido-em-campanha-na-bahia/), [BNews](https://www.bnews.com.br/noticias/politica/jeronimo-ironiza-consultoria-prestada-por-acm-neto-ao-banco-master.html)

## 4. Base rates
- PT has won every Bahia governor race since 2006: Wagner in 2006 and 2010, Rui Costa in 2014 and 2018, and Jerônimo in 2022.
- 2022 was a close parallel. ACM Neto led most polls before the vote. Jerônimo won the first round about 49.5% to 40.8%, then the runoff about 52.8% to 47.2%. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Bahia_gubernatorial_election)
- In 2022, polls underestimated PT in Bahia.
- Brazilian governors running for re-election usually win, though I did not find a precise rate.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs a "Bahia Governor Election Winner" market. Its page showed Jerônimo about 55% and ACM Neto about 43%, but the snapshot is undated. I could not confirm a price from September 14 or earlier. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/bahia-governor-election-winner)
- Kalshi lists a market (KXBAHIAGOV). [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxbahiagov/bahia-governor-winner/kxbahiagov-26oct04)
- Manifold also has a market. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Brierbr/brazil-2026-election-who-will-be-el-tCNuNQgyqz)
- I did not get current prices from Kalshi or Manifold.

## 6. Upcoming events
- Further polls before the first round (Quaest, AtlasIntel, Paraná Pesquisas, Real Time Big Data) and TV debates.
- Possible new steps in the Banco Master investigation, which could hit the PT or ACM Neto.
- A pending court ruling on ACM Neto's candidate registration (status not confirmed).
- 2026-10-04: first round. Minor candidates poll around 2-4% combined, so the race could end in the first round or go to a runoff.
- 2026-10-25: runoff, if needed.

- **Paraná Pesquisas, July-August:** ACM Neto led by about 10-11 points.
- **Quaest, July 29:** a 39% to 38% tie. Jerônimo had higher rejection (40% vs 30%) but 57% government approval.
- **Trend:** ACM Neto's summer lead collapsed once free TV and radio campaign time began. The PT machine in Bahia, Lula's strength in the Northeast, and the 2022 polling miss all favor Jerônimo.
- **Market anchor:** Polymarket showed roughly 55/43 for Jerônimo, though the snapshot is undated.
- **Counterweight:** Jerônimo's high rejection rate and the Banco Master scandal touching PT figures in Bahia help ACM Neto.

**Adjustment:** I start from the market's roughly 55% for Jerônimo and move up a few points. The reasons are the documented 2022 polling bias toward the opposition in Bahia and the momentum toward the incumbent. I stop short of the full base rate because the race is genuinely tied.

**(e) Unexpected scenario:** A Banco Master development implicates Jerônimo directly, and ACM Neto wins the runoff. Alternatively, a court ruling bars ACM Neto's registration, leaving União Brasil to field a substitute (possibly Bruno Reis), which would make "Bruno Soares Reis" or "Other" possible. Both paths are low probability.
